C1: Usually no cutaneous dermatome; retain C1 for its motor roots.
C2: Posterior scalp and upper neck; occipital landmark.
C5: Lateral upper arm; lateral elbow landmark.
C6: Lateral forearm and thumb; thumb landmark.
T2: Medial upper arm and axilla; axillary landmark.
T3: Upper thoracic band; third intercostal landmark.
T4: Thoracic band at the nipple-line landmark.
T5: Thoracic band below T4; fifth intercostal landmark.
T7: Upper abdominal band below the xiphoid level.
T8: Abdominal band between xiphoid and umbilical levels.
T9: Abdominal band immediately above the umbilical level.
T10: Abdominal band at the umbilical landmark.
T11: Lower abdominal band below the umbilicus.
T12: Lowest thoracic abdominal band, above the groin.
L1: Inguinal and upper medial thigh region.
L3: Distal anterior thigh and medial knee landmark.
L4: Medial leg and medial ankle landmark.
L5: Dorsum of the foot and great-toe region.
S3: Lower buttock and perineal region; ischial landmark.
S4: Perianal territory, overlapping S5; examined together as S4–5 in ISNCSCI.
S5: Central perianal territory, overlapping S4; examined together as S4–5 in ISNCSCI.
Co1: Small anococcygeal territory near the coccyx, via the shared S4–Co1 coccygeal plexus; not a separate ISNCSCI sensory test point.
